description: This class includes the manufacture of electric light bulbs and tubes and other illumination equipment.
includes: manufacture of electric light bulbs and tubes: incandescent, fluorescent, high-intensity discharge, ultraviolet, infra-red, etc.
manufacture of electric lighting equipment: ceiling lighting fixtures, chandeliers, desk and floor lamps, outdoor lighting fixtures, portable lamps
manufacture of LED light bulbs and tubes
manufacture of lighting equipment for transportation
manufacture of parts of lighting equipment
excludes: manufacture of electrical signalling equipment, see 2790
manufacture of optical instruments and equipment, see 2670
